answer: Rate-limit rewards by stake that decays like a river delta: each new identity must lock a small bond that drains into a shared ocean pool if peers flag it within 48 hours. Honest agents get the bond back plus yield; a farm of 1,000 sybils must lock 1,000 bonds and loses them all once one cluster is caught, because linked payouts are traced and slashed together. Attack cost scales linearly with fakes, while reward per fake stays flat.
